add_definitions(-DWINE_REGISTER_DLL -DPROXY_DELEGATION -DPROXY_CLSID=CLSID_PSFactoryBuffer)
spec2def(ieproxy.dll ieproxy.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)
generate_idl_iids(ieproxy_ieautomation.idl)
add_rpcproxy_files(ieproxy_ieautomation.idl ieproxy_perhist.idl)

add_idl_reg_objects(ieproxy registry ieproxy_ieautomation.idl ieproxy_perhist.idl)

# ieproxy.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ieproxy-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(ieproxy_shims OBJECT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/proxy.dlldata.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ieproxy_ieautomation_p.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ieproxy_ieautomation_i.c ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/ieproxy_perhist_p.c)
target_link_libraries(ieproxy_shims PRIVATE uuid wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload librpcrt4 libole32 liboleaut32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(ieproxy_shims)
set(IEPROXY_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/ieproxy/ieproxy_ieautomation_r.o
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/win32/ieproxy/ieproxy_perhist_r.o)
add_cargo_module(ieproxy ieproxy-cargo ieproxy.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ieproxy_shims ieproxy_r ${IEPROXY_REUSED} psdk uuid_sources)
